items.title: Give the merge-regression fixture story a verifier-owned acceptance basis so the DEV to REVIEW advance passes the pre-review gate
items.context: assertSimulatedMainMergeRegression in packages/main/src/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.ts builds a temp story and advances it DEV to REVIEW. runPreReviewCheckGate is unconditional for that transition and currentPreReviewInputForContext throws without a basis. Do not weaken the gate or skip the assertion; the fixture must earn the basis the way a real story does.

items.title: Prove the smoke is a real guard again, not merely green
items.context: After the fix, node packages/main/dist/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.js must exit 0, and a deliberate mutation of the behaviour the merge-regression case guards must still turn it red. Record both transcripts.
